research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Relay Therapeutics is focused on developing PI3K-alpha inhibitors, as evidenced by their work on crystalline forms, salts, and co-crystals of these compounds. They are also researching CDK inhibitors, which are novel compounds aimed at inhibiting CDK enzyme activity. Additionally, they are exploring bifunctional compounds that degrade estrogen receptor alpha, targeting disorders like endometriosis and cancer. These efforts highlight Relay Therapeutics' commitment to advancing drug discovery through computational techniques applied to protein motion.

overview_description.description: Relay therapeutics is a developer of an allosteric drug-discovery platform intended to apply computational techniques to protein motion.The company's platform detects and characterizes interactions that occur anywhere on a protein and combines computational methods with experimental approaches across the fields of structural biology, biophysics and chemistry, enabling pharmaceutical companies to solve and design therapies against complex diseases like cancer and others.
